jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
Dynamic Solution Innovators (DSi), a Dhaka-based software company, is hiring a Business Analyst with 1–3 years of experience. The role covers requirements analysis, process mapping, documentation, and client collaboration across pre-sales and project delivery, from opportunity assessment to final handover.

## Responsibilities

- Gather client needs, pain points, and expected outcomes through meetings, workshops, and site visits as needed.
- Document As-Is and To-Be processes, feature lists, epics, user stories, inception reports, and UI/UX flows.
- Work with the Documentation Team to develop Software Requirements Specifications (SRS) and Software Design Documents (SDD).
- Validate processes, workflows, and UI/UX designs with clients throughout the analysis phase.
- Collaborate with Sales and Tech Leads on project scoping, requirements discovery, and initial solution planning.
- Prepare scoping documents, milestone structures, and risk assessments, and develop effort estimates with Tech Lead support.
- Contribute technical content and process and architecture diagrams to RFP/EOI responses.
- Keep Project Managers, developers, QA, and UI/UX teams aligned on requirements throughout delivery. Provide ongoing clarifications and maintain accurate, consistent requirements as systems evolve.
- Lead client requirement walkthroughs, validation and feedback sessions, and presentations of workflows, prototypes, and To-Be processes to align stakeholders.
- Support Project Managers during user acceptance testing (UAT), piloting, and deployment.

## Requirements

- Have 1–3 years of experience.
- Communicate effectively in English and Bengali, explaining complex ideas clearly and concisely.
- Demonstrate strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.
- Organize information logically and produce clear, structured documentation.
- Have hands-on experience with business analysis documentation, including SRS, Business Requirements Documents (BRD), and As-Is and To-Be process documents.
- Show an interest in software systems and enthusiasm for organizing and documenting technical processes.
- Be proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, Google Sheets, and other productivity or collaboration tools.
- Have strong computer literacy and be willing to learn new technologies and tools quickly.
- Manage time effectively and handle multiple deliverables in parallel.

Preferred qualifications:

- Experience with Government of Bangladesh (GoB) projects is a plus.
- A bachelor’s degree in BBA, CS, CSE, EEE, ETE, or a related field is preferred.

## Work arrangements

- There are 2 weekly holidays: Friday and Saturday.
- Site visits may be required for requirements gathering.

## Salary and benefits

- Receive free lunch and snacks on campus.
- Receive 2 festival bonuses, healthcare coverage, and a yearly salary increment.
- Work alongside experienced professionals on international and government-level projects.
- Join a supportive environment that encourages learning.

## How to apply

The application deadline is 30 Oct 2026.

jobs.title: Customer Support Executive - Night Shift
jobs.description:
BRAC IT is hiring 2 Customer Support Executives to provide overnight support for a European rail and road freight logistics client. You will be the client’s sole customer-facing contact during the European night, handling mainly written B2B enquiries through Zendesk and checking transport information in an Oracle-based transport management system (TMS). The role supports operations that run 24/7 and includes a structured handover to the client’s daytime customer care team.

## Responsibilities

- Monitor and respond to overnight Zendesk tickets, acknowledging, triaging and resolving enquiries within agreed SLA response and resolution times.
- Categorise, prioritise and tag tickets accurately, and keep complete case notes for reporting and follow-up.
- Retrieve shipment, train, trailer and terminal status from the client’s Oracle-based TMS. Verify information across systems before replying, prioritising accuracy over speed.
- Flag missing data, outdated records and system inconsistencies to the client’s onshore team.
- Escalate issues beyond first-line support according to the agreed escalation matrix. Identify which cases can be resolved overnight and which must wait for the day shift.
- Hand over open, escalated and pending cases at the start of the client’s morning shift.
- Follow documented procedures and help maintain Zendesk knowledge articles, macros and response templates.
- Report recurring issues, process difficulties and potential automation opportunities to the BRAC IT team lead.
- Meet written-response standards for tone, accuracy and completeness. Support periodic reporting on ticket volumes, response times and recurring themes, and participate in calibration and quality reviews.

## Requirements

- You must hold a bachelor’s degree in any discipline and have 1–3 years of experience in customer support, service desk, BPO or shared-services operations.
- Excellent written English is the most important screening criterion. You must communicate clearly, professionally and concisely with European business customers.
- You must be willing and able to work permanent night shifts.
- You must be able to use multiple systems simultaneously, follow documented processes precisely and verify details before responding.
- You must demonstrate attention to detail, composure and sound judgement while working unsupervised overnight.
- The listed skills and experience also include hands-on use of Zendesk, Freshdesk, ServiceNow or a comparable ticketing platform; international client support, particularly for Europe; and a background in logistics, freight forwarding, supply chain or transportation.
- Familiarity with SLA-based service delivery and basic service metrics, plus exposure to ERP or transport management systems, is also listed.
- Working knowledge of Italian or French is listed as useful, with these languages considered more useful to the client than German. English alone is sufficient to start.
- A customer service certification, ITIL Foundation or a comparable service-management qualification is a plus, but is not mandatory.

## Work arrangements

- This is a full-time position in the Sales department, with 2 vacancies.
- The location is Dhaka, and the workplace type is listed as online.
- The role requires permanent night shifts covering the European overnight period.

## Hiring process

1. Attend an on-site technical/functional interview.
2. Attend an online HR interview.
3. Receive an offer if selected.

## How to apply

The application deadline is 15 October 2026.

## Responsibilities

- Review lesson plans, instructional materials, and teaching aids to ensure effective teaching and alignment with curriculum standards.
- Conduct regular physical and/or virtual classroom observations to assess teaching quality, instructional delivery, and student engagement.
- Analyze assessment data, grade averages, and performance trends to identify underperforming students and support appropriate interventions.
- Review chapter-end assessments, class tests, half-yearly, yearly, term, and other significant summative examination records. Provide timely feedback and reports to guide academic improvement.
- Ensure teachers complete assigned academic tasks, additional responsibilities, supporting guidelines, and required training.
- Monitor and verify teachers’ and school staff’s attendance, punctuality, and professional accountability.
- Track student attendance and work with relevant teams to maintain attendance rates at or above 80%.
- Ensure learning environments, instructional tools, and communication channels meet program guidelines and standards.
- Monitor and guide school and program activities, and help coordinate co-curricular activities, national observances, and academic events.
- Ensure teaching materials, teaching aids, question papers, assessment schedules, grading, result compilation, parent meetings, and report card days are accurate and completed on time.
- Support teachers and school teams in addressing challenges, and report needs or issues to the Supervisor, Administration, and HR teams.
- Maintain organized academic reports, classroom observation records, need-based assessments and grades, teacher feedback and performance records, and student progress data as directed by the Supervisor.
- Promote safe, inclusive, child-friendly learning environments through training, content, and other activities. Ensure educational practices and content comply with JAAGO Foundation’s Safeguarding Policy and Code of Conduct, and incorporate gender-sensitive and inclusive approaches.
- Carry out other academic or program duties assigned by the Supervisor or required by the organization to support institutional goals.

## Requirements

- A bachelor’s degree in Education, Sciences, Commerce, or a relevant discipline is required.
- Minimum 1–2 years of teaching experience or training in primary and/or secondary education, with strong subject knowledge, is required.
- Additional training or certification in pedagogy, assessment, teacher development, or education leadership is an advantage.
- Experience coaching SSC batches and related work experience are advantages.
- Candidates must understand curriculum alignment, lesson planning, and classroom pedagogy, and be able to analyze assessment data, identify learning gaps, and recommend practical interventions.
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills are needed to coach, mentor, and support teachers.
- Candidates must be organized, able to manage multiple tasks and school follow-ups, and capable of collaborating across teams while maintaining professional accountability.
- Digital literacy is required, including comfort with Google Workspace Docs, Sheets, and Slides, communication platforms, and basic data-tracking tools.

## Salary and benefits

- The salary is BDT 25,000–30,000 per month.

jobs.title: Research & Development (R&D) Officer
jobs.description:

The role connects agricultural research with practical farming and commercial opportunities.

## Responsibilities

- Design and conduct multi-location field trials, crop validation programmes, and product demonstrations.
- Monitor crop performance and collect soil, crop, and technical field data.
- Organize and lead farmer meetings, field days, technical seminars, dealer and retailer meetings, and demonstration sessions.
- Support market development and field promotion of innovative agricultural inputs.
- Analyze field data and prepare technical reports, trial dossiers, and compliance documents.
- Write scientific manuscripts and research papers for peer-reviewed or Scopus-indexed journals.
- Collaborate with farmers, dealers, agricultural universities, research institutions, and government agencies, including BARI, BRRI, and DAE.
- Provide technical guidance on crop protection, crop nutrition, and product applications.
- Work with Sales, Marketing, and Business Development teams to turn research findings into commercial opportunities.
- Train and mentor junior field teams, and support market intelligence and competitor analysis.

## Requirements

- Hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Agriculture or a relevant discipline, such as Agronomy, Soil Science, Horticulture, Plant Pathology, or Agricultural Chemistry.
- Have hands-on thesis or research experience.
- Have practical experience in agricultural field trials, technical data collection, research, or agri-business/technical marketing.
- Understand experimental design and statistical tools such as R, SPSS, or STAR.
- Demonstrate strong scientific and technical writing, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
- Be willing to travel extensively and work across rural Bangladesh.
- Candidates with 1-2 publications in Scopus-indexed or reputable peer-reviewed journals will receive strong preference.

- This is a full-time position based at the head office and in the field, with extensive travel across Bangladesh.

## Salary and benefits

- The salary is BDT 25,000-30,000.
- The role offers opportunities to work on emerging AgTech and precision agriculture solutions and apply research to real-world farming.

## Hiring process

Shortlisted candidates will be contacted about the next steps.

## How to apply

Complete WeGro Technologies Limited’s job application form with accurate information.

jobs.title: Programme Head; Climate and Environmental Innovation Programme

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Learning & Organisational Development
jobs.description:
BRAC is seeking a Senior Manager, Learning & Organisational Development to strengthen organisational effectiveness, leadership capability and employee experience. The role uses behavioural science, organisational psychology, adult learning and data to develop measurable interventions that support lasting behavioural change and a future-ready workforce.

- Diagnose behavioural, cultural, leadership, team effectiveness, employee engagement, psychological safety and capability gaps across programmes and functions, using relevant frameworks to identify root causes.
- Design and deliver evidence-based interventions covering diagnosis, design, implementation, reinforcement and impact measurement. Address leadership effectiveness, engagement, psychological safety, team dynamics, workplace behaviour, culture transformation and workforce capability.

- Research and incorporate global organisational development and behavioural practices to improve interventions and introduce innovative approaches.
- Create customised learning solutions aligned with organisational priorities, capability gaps and stakeholder needs. Develop leadership journeys, modules, facilitator guides, participant materials, case studies, simulations, experiential activities, assessments and digital resources.
- Facilitate leadership, behavioural and capability development for managers and leaders. Use adult learning, experiential learning, edutainment and other innovative methods while embedding BRAC values, empathy and behavioural principles.
- Build impact measurement frameworks using pre- and post-assessments, behavioural indicators, manager and participant feedback, and stakeholder evaluations. Assess capability gains, behavioural change, workplace application and intervention effectiveness.
- Analyse quantitative and qualitative data, prepare impact reports and use findings to guide decisions and improve future interventions.
- Provide internal organisational development consulting and partner with senior leaders to co-create solutions and identify emerging capability and future workforce needs.
- Strengthen facilitation, coaching and organisational development capabilities within the LLD team, and manage relationships with external experts, learning partners and relevant institutions.
- Protect programme participants, people in contact with BRAC and team members from harm, abuse, neglect, harassment and exploitation, including sexual exploitation and abuse (SEA). Provide safeguarding support, guidance and expertise to maintain a safe working environment.

## Requirements

- At least 8 years of total professional experience is required, including relevant experience in learning and development, organisational development, human resources, talent management or related fields.
- Experience in organisational behaviour, intervention design, facilitation, coaching or organisational consulting is an added advantage.
- Required knowledge covers organisational behaviour, organisational psychology, organisational development, behavioural science, learning and development, talent management, change management and leadership development.
- Required skills include organisational diagnosis, intervention design, content development, facilitation, research and data analysis, impact measurement and stakeholder consulting.
- Required competencies include systems thinking, emotional intelligence, influencing skills, strategic thinking, innovation and problem solving, partnership building and learning agility.

## Salary and benefits

jobs.title: Senior Specialist, Youth, Skills & Job Creation, Social Innovation Lab

jobs.title: Knowledge Management Analyst, NPSA 8, Dhaka, Bangladesh (UNCDF) - [Open to internal and external applicants]
jobs.description:
UNDP Bangladesh is recruiting a Knowledge Management Analyst at NPSA 8 level for UNCDF in Dhaka, Bangladesh. Open to internal and external applicants, the role supports communications, knowledge sharing, project delivery and resource mobilisation across UNCDF’s Bangladesh portfolio, under the supervision of the Country Lead.

## Responsibilities

- Plan campaigns, exhibitions, conferences, social events and other initiatives that explain UNCDF’s work and achievements to public and targeted audiences.
- Build relationships with national TV, radio and news agencies, propose media stories, and organise or participate in press trips, journalist briefings and partners’ press conferences.
- Brief and coordinate photographers, designers and videographers. Draft and edit media products, blog posts, web content, brochures and presentations with attention to regional cultural sensitivities.
- Develop strategies to strengthen visibility among partners, maintain communication on commitments, monitor readership and identify ways to expand the audience for Bangladesh communications materials.
- Coordinate publishing approvals and support with the Asia Regional Office and headquarters Partnerships and Communications teams. Help country and regional teams plan and produce knowledge management and communications assets.
- Develop and implement a learning agenda and knowledge-sharing strategy so lessons from one initiative inform others. Collect country-level results and share them across countries and regions to support learning and Bangladesh strategy.
- Identify innovative ways to communicate regional activities, achievements and lessons. Arrange regular partner webinars, online workshops and knowledge-sharing sessions that showcase project results.
- Help prepare grants and performance-based agreements, track progress, and lead quality assurance for approved partners and donors.
- Develop reporting systems, tools, indicators, reports and projections for ongoing projects, including periodic reporting to UNCDF headquarters, the regional team, Bangladesh Bank, the Ministry of Finance and other relevant stakeholders or ministries.
- Help onboard, manage and guide project interns to deliver high-quality work.
- Support technical assistance to private-sector partners and implementation of country initiatives to achieve portfolio results.
- Research Bangladesh’s political, social and economic conditions, contribute substantive inputs to country strategy, and support country assessments and other studies.
- Maintain regular partner contact, for example monthly, to monitor progress and satisfaction with UNCDF support. Participate in weekly project progress meetings with partners.
- Support reporting to donors and national stakeholders. Help review and respond to quarterly partner reports, check reporting accuracy and agreement or contract progress, and verify milestones and targets for disbursements.
- Organise project workshops, meetings and visits according to project plans.
- Update the donor map annually in consultation with the Country Lead, prepare donor briefs, and keep the corporate presentation of UNCDF’s Bangladesh activities and stakeholder list current.
- Ensure financial and narrative reports meet deadlines under donor Cost Sharing Agreements.
- Perform other duties within the role’s functional scope as needed for the office and organisation.

## Requirements

- A master’s degree or equivalent in Business Administration, Finance, Public Administration, Economics, Development Studies, Political Sciences, Social Sciences or a related field is required. A bachelor’s degree in these fields with an additional 2 years of experience may be considered instead.
- Applicants with a relevant master’s degree or equivalent do not need professional work experience.
- Applicants with a bachelor’s degree or equivalent must have at least two (2) years of relevant national or international professional experience in development finance, especially digital financial services. This experience must include programme support and hands-on development project design, monitoring and evaluation.
- Fluency in English and Bangla is required.
- Level 1 core competencies cover delivering accurate work on time, practical problem-solving and innovation, continuous learning, adaptability, determination under pressure, positive relationships, and respect for diversity and inclusion, including addressing bias and discrimination.
- Technical competencies include systems thinking; researching and translating information into useful knowledge and workable solutions; managing stakeholder partnerships; planning and controlling project resources; managing efficient operations; developing digital audience-engagement strategies; and planning and executing events that support communications, advocacy and UNCDF’s mandate.

The following skills and experience are desired:

- Excellent spoken and written communication, drafting, formulation and reporting skills, with accuracy and professionalism in document production and editing.
- Experience with international development organisations and development project teams.
- Strong interpersonal skills, cultural and social sensitivity, and inclusive collaboration with grassroots communities, religious and youth organisations, and authorities at different levels.
- Familiarity with communications-for-development tools and approaches.
- The ability to adapt professionally in challenging environments and work effectively in multicultural teams of national and international personnel.
- Strong computer literacy, including MS Office applications such as Excel and Word, email and internet use, database management familiarity, and office technology equipment.
- Self-motivation, the ability to work with minimal supervision, and the ability to meet tight deadlines.
- Experience in financial inclusion and digital financial services, particularly for vulnerable groups such as women garment workers or migrant families.

## Work arrangements

- The position is based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, at NPSA 8 level and reports to the Country Lead for Bangladesh.
- The analyst works with UNCDF’s Bangladesh and regional teams, UNDP Bangladesh, donors, key external stakeholders and the UNCDF Regional Communications Specialist.
- Weekly country team meetings require updates on work arrangements and project activities.
- Monthly regional calls require presentations on project progress, plans for the following month and potential risks.
- Participation in working groups and steering committee meetings is required when requested.

## Hiring process

- UNDP uses a tiered recruitment approach. Tier 0 covers UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff on permanent (PA) or fixed-term (FTA) appointments whose posts will be abolished or whose contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026. Tier 1 covers other staff in those organisations on PA or FTA appointments. Tier 2 covers staff on temporary appointments, personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers. Tier 3, or vacancies without a stated tier, covers other contract types, applicants from other agencies and external candidates.
- Selection is based on merit and suitability without discrimination. Qualified applicants from all backgrounds are encouraged to apply.
- Selected candidates undergo relevant checks and must uphold standards prohibiting harassment, sexual harassment, exploitation, discrimination and abuse of authority.
- UNDP may select one or more candidates and retain applications for similar positions at the same grade with comparable duties, experience and education requirements.
- UNDP charges no fee at any stage of recruitment.

## How to apply

- Check any tier indicated in the vacancy title and ensure you meet its eligibility requirements. This vacancy is advertised as open to internal and external applicants.

jobs.title: Project Analyst (Monitoring, Evaluation & Learning) - [Open to internal and external applicants]
jobs.description:
UNDP Bangladesh is recruiting a Project Analyst (Monitoring, Evaluation & Learning), open to internal and external applicants, for the Social Security Policy Support (SSPS) Phase II programme (2026–2030). Implemented with the Government of Bangladesh and Australia’s Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT), the programme supports National Social Security Strategy (NSSS) reforms to improve inclusive, lifecycle-based, climate-responsive and fiscally sustainable social protection.

## Responsibilities

- Lead the design, implementation and periodic review of the project’s MEL plan, results framework, indicators, monitoring tools, performance tracking systems and reporting templates.
- Coordinate monitoring of outputs, outcomes and milestones across thematic portfolios. Ensure timely collection, verification, analysis and reporting of quantitative and qualitative data, conduct data quality assessments, and maintain reliable monitoring databases.
- Coordinate Results-Oriented Annual Reports (ROAR), DFAT and other donor reports, annual and periodic progress reports, and corporate reporting. Coordinate evaluations, reviews and assessments, including management responses and follow-up on recommendations.
- Produce analytical reports, lessons learned, case studies, outcome stories and other evidence products. Facilitate reflection and learning, contribute MEL expertise to technical documents, policy papers, concept notes, research and programme design, and connect evidence with management decisions.
- Administer, maintain and improve the NSSS M&E Dashboard, NSSS Reform Tracking Dashboard and related digital evidence systems. Guide project personnel and government counterparts in using dashboards and digital MEL platforms.
- Oversee integration with the Single Registry MIS, government MIS, mobile applications and other interoperable platforms. Develop monitoring architecture linking national, sub-national and local data, strengthen feedback loops, and promote data governance, quality, interoperability, information security and data protection.
- Use data analytics and visualization to turn programme and administrative data into dashboards, analytical outputs and decision-support information.
- Monitor and document programme pilots, incorporating implementation experience, results, beneficiary data and lessons into MEL and programme improvement. Strengthen the capture, tracking, analysis and reporting of grievances and beneficiary feedback, including Grievance Redress System (GRS) evidence.
- Analyse local, pilot and beneficiary data to identify service-delivery gaps, targeting challenges, inclusion and exclusion issues, and opportunities for institutionalization or scale-up.
- Support the policy and MEL interface for the Bangladesh Multidimensional Household Well-being Panel Survey with BBS, Cabinet Division, General Economics Division (GED) and other stakeholders. Define policy questions and use cases, and apply survey and pilot evidence to SDG localization, Family Card learning, social protection targeting and programme performance.
- Within the agreed institutional division of responsibilities, contribute to indicator frameworks, data access, privacy and ethics, analysis and publication planning, methods review and learning. Translate findings into recommendations and products supporting adaptation, policy dialogue and potential scale-up.
- Lead the administration, security, maintenance and development of the National Website on Social Protection and related evidence platforms. Manage its WordPress content management system, including users, publishing workflows, performance, backups and security.
- Coordinate publication of policy documents, research, dashboards and knowledge products. Develop links and functionality connecting websites, dashboards, monitoring systems and mobile applications, and use platform analytics to improve access and dissemination.
- Support learning and knowledge-sharing events through digital registration, QR-based attendance, electronic feedback, digital materials and presentation tools. Incorporate participation and feedback data into programme learning.
- Coordinate monitoring, reporting, evidence generation, data-sharing and validation with government institutions, implementing partners, UN agencies, development partners, academia and civil society. Provide technical guidance on RBM, MEL, data quality, evidence use, digital systems and reporting.
- Prepare and present monitoring reports, dashboards, findings and briefing materials for the Project Board, Project Steering Committee, Technical Committee, donors and other strategic meetings.
- Build government and project personnel’s capacity in MEL, RBM, evidence use, data management, dashboards, digital systems, GRS and knowledge management.
- Integrate gender equality, disability inclusion, human rights and Leave No One Behind principles into monitoring, analysis, digital systems, evaluations and learning products.
- Monitor relevant risks, assumptions and mitigation measures, and contribute to updates of the Project Risk Log. Support compliance with UNDP Programme and Operations Policies and Procedures (POPP), Central M&E requirements, corporate reporting standards, information-security requirements, audit recommendations and other applicable standards.
- Supervise the Project Associate (Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning) and Project Associate (MIS), and undertake other duties within the role’s functional profile as needed.

## Requirements

**Mandatory qualifications and experience**

- A master’s degree or equivalent in Monitoring and Evaluation, Statistics, Data Science, Applied Statistics and Data Science, Information Technology, Computer Science or a related discipline is required. A bachelor’s degree in these fields with an additional two years of qualifying experience will be considered instead.
- Applicants must have at least 2 years of relevant experience with a master’s degree or 4 years with a bachelor’s degree. Experience must cover monitoring and evaluation, results-based management, data analysis, programme/project management or related fields in a policy support or advocacy project.
- Experience developing and maintaining results frameworks, indicators, monitoring tools, databases and performance tracking systems is required.
- Applicants must have experience collecting, validating, analysing, interpreting and presenting quantitative and qualitative data, including survey and/or administrative data, for programme and policy decisions.
- Experience with digital monitoring and information systems, such as dashboards, MIS, data integration or technology-enabled reporting tools, is required.
- Experience preparing analytical reports, evaluations, lessons learned, policy-oriented evidence products and other knowledge outputs is required.
- Applicants must have experience working with government institutions and multi-stakeholder partnerships, including development partners, UN agencies, implementing partners or other relevant stakeholders.
- Fluency in English and Bangla is required.

**Competencies**

- Applicants should demonstrate results-based management, project planning and resource management, data inspection, cleansing, transformation and modelling, and knowledge of inclusive growth and social protection.
- The role requires business intelligence and analytics capabilities, including structuring data and developing dashboards and data warehouses, alongside website design, coding and development skills.
- UNDP’s Level 2 core competencies apply: improving and scaling solutions while balancing speed and accuracy; innovative and integrated thinking; continuous learning and support for others’ learning; adapting approaches and involving others in change; perseverance under multiple pressures; building partnerships and coalitions; and facilitating dialogue across differences while considering diversity in decisions.
- UNDP People Management Competencies also apply.

**Preferred qualifications and experience**

- Experience with UNDP ROAR, Quantum, Central M&E, corporate reporting, audit or comparable UN systems is desirable.
- Experience with social protection systems and the NSSS, including monitoring frameworks, government data systems, targeting and policy reform, is desirable.
- Experience administering or overseeing digital MEL, information or knowledge platforms is desirable, including dashboards, MIS, websites, content management systems, mobile applications and interoperable systems. Relevant exposure includes data integration, quality, security and system enhancement.
- Experience with Power BI, Tableau, SQL, R, Python, Stata or comparable analytical technologies is desirable.
- Experience analysing household surveys, panel/longitudinal, administrative, beneficiary or programme data is desirable, including BBS/HIES, iBAS++, social protection MIS or comparable datasets. Relevant applications include poverty, multidimensional well-being, coverage, targeting, inclusion/exclusion errors and programme performance.
- Experience with beneficiary feedback or grievance redress systems, and applying gender equality, disability inclusion, human rights and Leave No One Behind principles to monitoring and evidence generation, is desirable.
- Experience producing policy briefs, analytical reports, dashboards, case studies, research or other knowledge products is desirable, including at least one published analytical or knowledge product as lead or co-author.
- Experience with WordPress content management systems and digital knowledge-management platforms is desirable.
- Working knowledge of another UN language is desirable.
- Professional certification in RBM, Risk Management, Evaluation, PMP, PRINCE2 or an equivalent is desired.

## Work arrangements

- The analyst will work under the direct supervision of the National Project Manager of SSPS Program II.
- The analyst will also report to and receive technical guidance from the Project Adviser (Technical) on MEL, evidence generation, data analytics and related substantive matters.

jobs.title: Security Officer (Open to Internal and External Applicants)
jobs.description:
UNDP Bangladesh is recruiting a Security Officer, open to internal and external applicants, to support safe programme delivery across Bangladesh, including remote and security-sensitive locations. The role works within the United Nations Security Management System (UNSMS) and UNDP security policies, supporting the Country Office’s compliance with the framework coordinated by UNDSS.

## Responsibilities

- Prepare and analyse security risk assessments for programmes, projects and operations, including in the Chittagong Hill Tracts and other field locations. Recommend mitigation measures for approval by the Resident Representative or Operations Advisor.
- Integrate security considerations and costs into programme design, implementation and delivery. Assess how security trends affect programmes and how programme design affects stability and security.
- Provide inputs to UNDSS for country and area-specific assessments and related documentation. Apply the Person-Centred Approach to identified threats, risks and vulnerabilities.
- Help establish, maintain and test security and contingency plans in coordination with UNDSS, following the UN Security Policy Manual and country-specific Security Risk Management process.
- Work with Human Resources and Procurement to keep personnel and eligible family member records current, ensuring that all UNDP personnel, including project personnel and eligible dependants, are included in the UNDSS Security Plan.
- Prepare security inputs for the Country Office Business Continuity Plan, aligned with UNDP Business Continuity Management, Enterprise Risk Management and the UN Country Team Business Continuity Plan.
- Monitor and report compliance with Security Risk Management Measures and Residential Security Measures for premises, residences, equipment and personnel through the corporate Security Compliance Survey tool. Advise management on funding needs under the UN Mandated Security Measures mechanism.
- Coordinate fire safety, first aid, security communications and other security training with UNDSS. Prepare and process clearance requests for travel to restricted or field areas for the Operations Advisor’s approval.
- Provide daily work direction and technical guidance to the Security Assistant in the Chittagong Hill Tracts. Identify security personnel’s learning needs and coordinate relevant training opportunities.
- Brief and train national and international personnel on security guidelines, communications, travel precautions, emergencies and curfew arrangements. Maintain current security equipment inventories, communication systems and access controls.
- Give timely security advice to senior management, programme and project managers, and visiting personnel. Immediately report incidents involving UNDP personnel or eligible family members to the Resident Representative, Operations Advisor, Regional Security Advisor, Sub-Regional Security Specialist and UNDSS, and support coordinated 24-hour incident response.
- Liaise with UNDSS and other UN agencies’ security counterparts. Contact with national law enforcement, civil authorities and host Government security authorities must take place through UNDSS or alongside a designated UNDP staff member.
- Accompany the designated UNDP staff member at Security Cell, Area Security Management Team and Security Management Team meetings, providing technical inputs and briefing materials. Contribute to UNDP and UNSMS security knowledge networks.
- Periodically assess premises, guesthouses, vehicles and equipment, identify security gaps and recommend mitigation measures. Support physical security, visitor and vehicle screening, and access controls at Country Office and project premises.
- Provide technical support on UNDP security requirements in shared UN premises, keeping personnel safety central to recommendations.
- Perform other duties within the role’s functional scope as needed.

## Requirements

### Education and experience

Applicants must meet one of these education routes:

- An advanced university degree, such as a master’s degree or equivalent, in Social Sciences, Management, Security Studies or a related field. No professional work experience is required for applicants with a relevant master’s degree or equivalent.
- A relevant bachelor’s degree with an additional two (2) years of qualifying security or development-related work experience in place of the advanced degree. The minimum professional experience requirement for bachelor’s degree holders is two (2) years.
- Formal multi-year security management education, such as military or police Command and Staff College training of at least 9 months full-time, with senior-level command experience. Applicants using this route must also have at least two (2) years of relevant security or development professional experience.

Formal training in security risk management is an asset.

### Languages and competencies

- Fluency in written and spoken English and fluency in Bangla are required.
- Working knowledge of UNSMS and UNDP security policies, including the Security Policy Manual, Security Risk Management, Residential Security Measures and UNDSS structures, is required or must be acquired promptly upon engagement.
- Applicants should demonstrate the ability to assess threats, implement mitigation measures, design and test security plans and physical security systems, analyse security information, advise on security operations, and prepare for and respond to crises.
- Clear written and verbal communication is expected, with messages tailored to different audiences and appropriate use of internal, external, media and social media channels.
- Client management skills should include timely responses, consistent and practical solutions, anticipation of client needs, and contributions to customer service strategy.
- UNDP’s Level 2 core competencies cover results delivery, process improvement, innovative and integrated thinking, continuous learning, adaptability, perseverance under multiple pressures, partnership building, and inclusive decision-making. UNDP People Management Competencies also apply.

### Desired skills and experience

- Field security experience outside Dhaka, particularly in the Chittagong Hill Tracts, Cox’s Bazar or coastal districts, including work during civil disturbance, election-related unrest or major natural disaster response.
- Experience with the UN or another UNSMS organization, contributing to formal security risk assessments and applying the Person-Centred Approach.
- Experience monitoring security and residential compliance measures, and developing and testing security, contingency, evacuation, relocation or business continuity plans.
- Experience writing security analyses, advisories or senior management briefing notes, and liaising with Bangladesh’s law enforcement, armed forces or civil administration.
- Experience assessing premises and advising on access control, perimeter protection, CCTV and fire safety, including oversight of unarmed private security providers, security communications and personnel-tracking systems.
- Experience delivering security briefings, inductions or training, such as Security Awareness Training, fire safety, first aid, defensive driving or warden training. Applicants should indicate the audience and volume of training delivered.
- Supervisory or team leadership experience, or clear readiness to direct national security support personnel’s daily work.
- Proficiency with computers and standard office software, including MS Word and Excel, and familiarity with ERP or web-based management systems.

## Work arrangements

- The Resident Representative holds overall security accountability. The Operations Advisor provides direct daily supervision, while the Sub-Regional Security Specialist for Asia and the Pacific and the Regional Security Advisor provide technical supervision.
- The officer prepares analyses and recommendations. Decisions with operational risk consequences remain with the Resident Representative, Deputy Resident Representative or Operations Advisor.
- The role supports operations throughout Bangladesh and coordinated 24-hour incident response.

## Hiring process

- Recruitment uses a tiered approach. Tier 3, or vacancies without a stated tier, covers other contract types, applicants from other agencies and external candidates.
- UNDP bases selection on merit and suitability and encourages qualified applicants from all backgrounds.
- Selected candidates undergo relevant checks and must uphold standards prohibiting harassment, sexual harassment, exploitation, discrimination and abuse of authority.
- UNDP may select one or more candidates and retain applications for similar roles at the same grade with comparable duties, experience and education requirements.
- UNDP charges no fee at any stage of recruitment.

## How to apply

- Check any tier stated in the vacancy title and ensure that you meet its eligibility requirements. This vacancy is advertised as open to internal and external applicants.
- Review UNDP’s guidance on responsible AI use in recruitment and selection.

- Plan, launch, and manage campaigns across Meta (Facebook and Instagram), Google Ads (Search, Display, and YouTube), LinkedIn, and other relevant platforms.

NCC Bank PLC is hiring an RM / SRM, Corporate Banking (SEO-VP) to grow its corporate client portfolio, manage client relationships and maintain credit quality.

## Responsibilities

- Identify, acquire and onboard corporate clients in line with the bank’s business strategy.
- Develop long-term client relationships, deliver responsive service and support client satisfaction and retention.
- Achieve loan/investment and deposit targets by expanding the customer base and cross-selling or up-selling products suited to client needs.
- Visit existing and prospective clients regularly to strengthen relationships, identify opportunities and offer proactive solutions.
- Resolve client concerns promptly and provide a seamless, one-stop banking experience.
- Analyse financial information, assess creditworthiness and prepare credit/investment proposals to support lending decisions.
- Monitor portfolio quality, minimise non-performing loans and support sustainable asset growth while ensuring compliance with bank policies, credit/investment standards and regulatory requirements.
- Prepare and review credit/investment proposals, call reports, office notes and memos. Maintain accurate management information system records and properly document and archive client files.
- Update senior management on business, industry and regulatory developments.
- Coordinate with credit/investment, operations, compliance, audit and other internal teams, as well as external stakeholders, to ensure smooth operations and timely service.
- Carry out other responsibilities assigned by management to support the department.

## Requirements

- Applicants must hold an MBA, MBM, master’s degree or four-year bachelor’s degree from a UGC-approved university, preferably in business, with no third class in their academic records.
- Applicants must have at least 16 years of schooling.
- Applicants must have at least 5 years of banking experience, including at least 3 years in corporate banking at a commercial bank or financial institution.
- Professional certification in Islamic Banking is preferred.
- Candidates currently working at a Shariah-based bank will receive preference.
- An MTO/PO background, or recruitment through a competitive examination at a commercial bank or financial institution, is preferred.

## Work arrangements

- This is a full-time, office-based role.
- Positions are based in Chattogram and Dhaka.

## Salary and benefits

- Salary is negotiable.
- Selected candidates will receive an attractive compensation package based on experience and competency.

## How to apply

- Apply through the NCC Bank PLC listing on bdjobs.com by **25 October 2026**.
- Before applying, ensure your CV is ATS-friendly and tailored to this role.

- Coordinate with supervisors and planners to meet promised delivery dates and lead times for customer orders and priority shipments.
- Carry out capital expenditure (Capex) planning based on operational forecasts and manage cost evaluations in Oracle.
- Maintain quality systems and procedures, investigate failures through root cause analysis, and implement corrective actions.
- Work with planners and supervisors to maximize machine and personnel utilization, production output, UEE, and UPLH.
- Provide technical and administrative support for sampling lead-time targets, sample quality, and new sample development with GPD.
- Assess best practices across key sites, introduce improved processes, increase contribution margins, and establish Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
- Apply Lean problem-solving methods and teach supervisors and operators to use them for production issues.
- Lead cost-saving and sustainable engineering projects to improve material utilization, reduce scrap, and meet productivity targets.
- Coordinate with pre-press, supply chain, material planning, and maintenance teams to maintain uninterrupted production and support Total Productive Maintenance (TPM), automation, new machine installations, and product deployments.
- Oversee health and safety compliance, multi-skilling, departmental discipline, housekeeping, and cross-functional operational coverage.

## Requirements

- A Bachelor of Science in Industrial & Production Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering field is required.
- Candidates must have at least 8 years of relevant experience in production and manufacturing operations.
- Candidates must have a thorough understanding of manufacturing processes and operational management.
- Strong technical, leadership, and decision-making skills are required.
- Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills are required.
- Candidates must demonstrate the ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced, target-oriented environment.
- Experience in Lean manufacturing, TPM, and root cause analysis is required.
- Familiarity with Oracle ERP and production planning tools is required.

jobs.title: Director, Human Resources and Administration
jobs.description:
EDOTCO Bangladesh is seeking a Director, Human Resources and Administration to lead its people strategy and workplace operations. The role partners with the Country Managing Director (CMD) and leadership team to support business priorities, transformation and long-term growth.

## Responsibilities

- Lead strategy and governance across the employee lifecycle, advising the CMD and Management Committee on workforce, leadership, talent, performance, culture and organisational matters.
- Oversee talent acquisition and retention of critical capabilities. Manage succession planning for leadership and business-critical roles, including identified successors, development plans and retention strategies.
- Develop learning and capability-building strategies for current and future business needs. Address capability gaps and build pipelines of leadership, commercial, technical and functional talent.
- Lead organisation design and strategic workforce planning, aligning structure, staffing, capabilities and costs with business strategy. Improve productivity, management spans and layers, role clarity and organisational effectiveness using analytics and benchmarking.
- Lead people-related work during transformation, restructuring, ownership transitions and other major changes. Maintain organisational readiness, leadership continuity, talent retention, employee communication and cultural integration while limiting business disruption.
- Manage grievances, disciplinary cases, workplace conflicts and other employee relations matters fairly, consistently and promptly, balancing legal obligations, organisational values and business interests.
- Ensure compliance with employment and labour laws, regulations and Group requirements. Maintain HR policies, records and governance, and mitigate employment-related legal, regulatory and reputational risks.
- Develop competitive, sustainable reward strategies based on business performance, market benchmarks and Group principles. Govern manpower and labour budgets through disciplined cost planning, forecasting and optimisation.
- Build a culture of performance and accountability through clear goals and differentiated performance management. Connect business results and individual contributions to rewards and development, address persistent underperformance and capability gaps, and embed EDOTCO’s values and leadership behaviours.
- Support employee safety, wellbeing and workplace requirements in coordination with HSE, Operations and other responsible functions, maintaining clear functional accountability.
- Improve HR and Administration productivity and costs through simpler processes, automation, organisational efficiency, demand management and vendor optimisation, while protecting essential employee services and capabilities.
- Coordinate employee communications, employer branding and change communications with Corporate Communications and relevant functions.
- Lead the people and workplace response to disruption or crises, supporting employee safety, workforce continuity, timely communication, leadership coordination and employee assistance under the company’s business continuity and crisis management framework.
- Promote an inclusive, respectful and merit-based workplace, with equal opportunities, leadership diversity and fair people practices.
- Strengthen policies, delegated authorities, segregation of duties, documentation, vendor controls and audit readiness. Work with Finance, GRC, Legal, Procurement and Internal Audit to resolve control gaps and close audit and compliance findings promptly.
- Establish people analytics and reporting on manpower, productivity, labour costs, attrition, critical talent, succession, performance, engagement and organisational health to support leadership decisions.
- Govern facilities, workplace management, transportation and fleet, physical security and employee services. Set measurable service levels, budgets and reporting for major administrative costs, with attention to service quality, asset utilisation, vendor performance, cost efficiency and internal controls.

## Requirements

- Hold a bachelor’s degree or equivalent from a recognised university in Human Resources, Business Administration, Management, Finance, Economics, Engineering or a related discipline.
- Have a minimum of 15 years of progressive experience in Human Resources and/or People & Organisation leadership, including at least 5 years in a senior leadership role within a large, complex organisation.
- Demonstrate experience leading organisational transformation, restructuring, organisation design, workforce optimisation, senior talent and succession planning, employee relations and Administration.
- Show a proven record of managing a broad HR and Administration agenda, including workforce planning, talent, performance, rewards, change management and governance.
- Build strong relationships and influence the CMD, Management Committee, employees, Group functions, relevant external parties and Board-level stakeholders where required.
- Develop and execute medium-to-long-term people and organisation strategies. Handle sensitive organisational issues and competing stakeholder interests, translating business strategy into practical workforce actions.
- Demonstrate strong business and commercial judgement, including an understanding of business drivers and financial implications.
- Advise, influence and constructively challenge the CMD and senior leadership with independence, sound judgement and courage.
- Bring strong analytical skills in workforce planning, productivity, labour costs and people analytics, alongside a strong focus on governance and controls.
- Demonstrate integrity, discretion and resilience, with the ability to lead through ambiguity, organisational change and sensitive people situations.
- A postgraduate qualification and/or recognised professional HR qualification would be advantageous.
- Experience in a multinational, telecommunications, digital infrastructure, technology, engineering or another asset-intensive/service environment is strongly preferred.

jobs.title: Engineer, Network Operations
jobs.description:
bKash Limited is hiring an Engineer, Network Operations in Jessore to maintain network availability, reliability, performance, and security. The role covers monitoring, troubleshooting, incident management, and maintenance across data centers, enterprise networks, remote sites, and partner environments.

## Responsibilities

- Monitor network connectivity, availability, and performance, and ensure the network operations roster is maintained across data centers, enterprise networks, third-party and partner networks, and remote sites.
- Configure, manage, and troubleshoot IP networks, routers, switches, firewalls, LANs, wireless networks, VPNs, and related infrastructure.
- Maintain connectivity and resolve issues using TCP/IP, LAN/WAN, Ethernet, VLAN, STP, LACP, BGP, OSPF, static routing, and network security technologies.
- Support data center networking and high availability, including DC/DR and new-site network readiness, traffic switchover, and service migration.
- Manage and troubleshoot enterprise firewalls and VPN technologies, including IPsec, IKE, and NAT.
- Monitor network health and performance using tools such as Cacti, Smokeping, Grafana, and SolarWinds. Use Wireshark for packet-level troubleshooting when needed.
- Coordinate network onboarding, implementation, troubleshooting, and technical support with connectivity vendors, third-party partners, product vendors, and OEMs.
- Manage network assets, inventory, and Linux/UNIX platform configuration requirements, and contribute to network optimization and automation.

## Requirements

- A Bachelor of Science in Computer Science or Computer Science & Engineering (CS/CSE) is required.
- Candidates must have 1–2 years of hands-on experience in IP network configuration and management, routing and switching, and configuring routers, switches, and firewalls.
- Experience managing LANs, wireless networks, site-to-site and user VPNs, and network monitoring solutions is required.
- Candidates need working knowledge of SDN, SD-Access, SD-WAN, network asset and inventory management, and Linux/UNIX platforms.
- Strong troubleshooting skills across network, operating system, and hardware environments are required, along with knowledge of server, storage, networking, routing, security, and port-channel technologies.
- Candidates must understand TCP/IP, VLAN, STP, LACP, BGP, OSPF, VPN, DNS, DHCP, NTP, SNMP, Syslog, NetFlow, and network monitoring.
- Hands-on experience with Cisco routers and switches is required, together with familiarity with enterprise firewalls such as Cisco, Palo Alto, Check Point, or similar platforms.
- Experience with Wireshark and packet-level troubleshooting is required.
- Basic knowledge of network automation using Python, Ansible, or APIs is an advantage.
- Vendor certifications such as CCNA/CCNP or RHCE, or certifications related to server, storage, and backup, are preferred.

## Work arrangements
